content:
maya: Heads up — main pipeline turned red immediately after merge of PR #3421 (sha abc123). CI run: https://ci.redwood.dev/run/6789. Failing step: integration/gateway-queue. Anyone oncall to triage?

deploy-bot: ALERT: pipeline red — run 6789 failed on step 'integration/gateway-queue' (exit 1). Logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/logs/6789. Rerun allowed.

sam: @maya grabbing this. Re-running flaky jobs now: /rerun 6789 -> started run 6790 :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

deploy-bot: RERUN STARTED: run 6790 (triggered by sam).

ryan: I noticed this pattern on Friday — usually flakes on 'TestQueueBackpressure' when a queue snapshot race happens. Logs show 'panic: queue closed' in those cases.

jordan: If the rerun passes we can probably mark as transient, but if it fails again we should bisect or revert. @oncall any objections to revert if it reproduces 2/2?

sam: rerun 6790 still red, same failure. Trimmed stack from the logs below:
```
panic: queue closed
goroutine 42 [running]:
redwood/server/queue.(*Queue).Pop(... )
redwood/tests/integration/gateway_test.go:157
```

maya: Thanks. @jordan can you start a bisect on the recent commits? If the bisect points to the last merge I'll open a revert PR to unblock main.

jordan: Starting bisect on commit range abc000..abc123. Will report back in ~20m. :mag_right:

lee: I'm pulling the failing node's VM logs and checking resource graphs — could be a memory regression from the merge.

deploy-bot: NOTE: infra autoscaler triggered scale-up during run 6789. Events show pod OOMKilled x1.

ryan: OOMKilled + queue closed aligns with a spike in in-memory objects (batcher/cache). Could be the batcher sizing change in the last PR. Tagging @eng-runtime for visibility.

maya: Plan: jordan bisects, lee inspects node metrics, sam prepares a revert if bisect narrows it to the recent merge. If this blocks customer-facing workload I'll open an incident in #incidents. Ping here if you need help. :eyes:

jordan: Bisect found suspected offending commit abc120 (batcher sizing tweak). Opening a revert candidate now.

sam: Created revert PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3490 — CI queued. If that passes and main turns green we should merge immediately.

maya: Great work, team. I'll stand by to merge the revert if CI on it is clean. :thumbsup:
